title: the MM2 arc opener
audit_comment: THE MM2 ARC OPENER - round zero of the Monster Manual II arc (the user Go call on the new-book candidate, after the next-arc audit found every standing book arc closed). The report mirrors the book structure lossless: the front matter with the preface and acknowledgements, the how-to-use doctrine in three boxes (the number-ranges table, the general entries, the special entries), the A-Z letter boxes with the pin-time sub-census doctrine (the R792 lesson applied at opener - the family sub-rosters walk from the print, never from OCR), the three encounter-table groups, the Index. THIS ROUND pins the front-matter doctrine: the frequency percentages (very rare 3, rare 7, uncommon 20, common 65, unique one), the magic resistance 11th-level base with the 5-percent step, the 8-sided hit-die default, the intelligence ladder bands with the godlike 21 floor, the multi-mode move notation, the MM1 treasure-type reference, the human attack matrix for the demihuman types, the plane and class lines of the special entries. FIVE FLIPS: the front matter, the how-to-use parent and its three doctrine boxes. The gap report is NEW (the R564 opener pattern): published PRE-FLIP, rverify in working-tree mode.

banner.title: THE MM2 ARC OPENER - the front-matter doctrine, the five flips, and the lossless MM2 gap report
banner.provenance: Round zero of the Monster Manual II arc (the user Go call, 2026-10-23). The opener capture is the Curtiss PDF upload (the front matter, pp. 1-7, clean text); the archive.org dual scans are the structural source for the A-Z roster and the table groups. The report mirrors the book with the A-Z sub-censuses deferred to pin time per the R792 census-correction lesson. The round pins the how-to-use doctrine as consts and bools - the frequency percentages, the magic resistance base and step, the hit-die sides, the intelligence ladder floor for godlike, the page anchors of the five book parts - and flips the five front-matter boxes. Registry 478 live, unchanged; the battery census reads loaded 478, errors 0.

consts.name: mmaOpenerRound
consts.comment: The MM2 arc opener: round zero of the Monster Manual II book (the user Go call)

consts.name: mmaBookPages
consts.comment: The printed page count of MM2 (1983, TSR 2021, Gary Gygax, preface dated October 1982)

consts.name: mmaAZFirstPage
consts.comment: The Monsters from A-Z first printed page

consts.name: mmaAZLastPage
consts.comment: The Monsters from A-Z last printed page

consts.name: mmaTablesFirstPage
consts.comment: The Random Encounter Tables first printed page (to 155; the Index rides at 156)

consts.name: mmaFreqVeryRarePct
consts.comment: Frequency doctrine: very rare is a 3 percent chance of occurrence

consts.name: mmaFreqUniqueCount
consts.comment: Frequency doctrine: unique means only one of the creatures exists

consts.name: mmaMagicResistBaseLevel
consts.comment: Magic resistance base: the percentage is against an 11th-level caster

consts.name: mmaMagicResistStepPct
consts.comment: Magic resistance step: 5 percent per level below or above the 11th-level base

consts.name: mmaHitDieSides
consts.comment: Hit dice are 8-sided unless stated otherwise; the plus adds hit points after the roll

consts.name: mmaIntelGodlikeLow
consts.comment: The intelligence ladder floor for godlike intelligence (the ladder rides from 0 non-intelligent)

bools.name: mmaMonsterTermIsGeneric
bools.comment: The first meaning of monster is generic - any creature encountered, human, humanoid or beast, hostile or not

bools.name: mmaFrequencyPercentsPinned
bools.comment: The frequency percentages are pinned as consts and reflected in the encounter tables within statistical limits

bools.name: mmaMoveNotationMultiMode
bools.comment: The move notation carries the modes: slash flying, double slash swimming, parentheses burrowing, star web, at-sign trees

bools.name: mmaManeuverabilityFromDMG
bools.comment: The maneuverability classes A through E are explained in the DMG, not restated here

bools.name: mmaHitDiceEightSidedDefault
bools.comment: Hit dice are 8-sided by default; low-hit creatures roll smaller dice by hit-point range notation

bools.name: mmaTreasureTypesFromMM1
bools.comment: Treasure types refer to the MM1 treasure tables; incidental treasure is noted as the accidental kind

bools.name: mmaMagicResistanceElevenBase
bools.comment: Magic resistance is stated at the 11th-level base with the 5-percent per-level adjustment, and saving throws still apply

bools.name: mmaHumanMatrixForDemiHumans
bools.comment: Humans and the demihuman types always use the human attack matrices, monster or player character

bools.name: mmaIntelligenceLadderIQ
bools.comment: The intelligence ratings correspond to character intelligence bands, from non-intelligent 0 to godlike 21-plus

bools.name: mmaSpecialEntriesPlaneAndClass
bools.comment: The special entries are the plane line and the class lines: cleric/druid, fighter, magic-user/illusionist, thief/assassin, monk/bard

bools.name: mmaSizeBandsAreThree
bools.comment: Size is three bands: S smaller than human, M human-sized, L larger - size feeds weapon damage

bools.name: mmaLevelXpRideDMGMethod
bools.comment: Level and experience point values follow the DMG method; varying hit dice show each value
